question: Is there existing work that already trains language models on context-enriched triple subgraphs (i.e., not just isolated triples but also surrounding triples from the same passage) for multi-hop KGQA?
description: Determine if the core idea of enriching target triples with local context subgraphs from the same source passage has been explored.
rationale: If such work exists, the novelty claim is weakened; if not, the idea is novel.
resolution: Yes, arXiv:2609.12230 proposes a context-augmented training framework that attaches supporting triples from the same source text chunk to each primary KG triple, forming a context graph, and trains under KG-grounded and CG-grounded supervision.
